title: Persistent serverless foundation — architecture audit and infrastructure design (Neon/R2/Upstash/worker model)
objective: Audit the deployed serverless state problem and design the correct persistent foundation within frozen Architecture v1.1: stateless Vercel application functions over authoritative Neon PostgreSQL + Cloudflare R2 with non-authoritative Upstash Redis coordination, plus a persistent CAD/BIM worker model and dependency-ordered migration roadmap. Documentation-only; zero code and zero protected-path changes.
acceptance_criteria: Audit the governing authority set and relevant web/electron/application surfaces.
Trace NEW/LINE/UNDO/REDO/SELECTALL/SAVE/OPEN and document session lifecycle with state placement classification.
Establish actual production deployment configuration from repository evidence with no assumed infrastructure.
Produce human- and machine-readable five-category state inventory.
Define Neon schema, R2 content-addressed namespace, Redis key inventory, and transactional concurrency boundaries with typed conflicts.
Define durable worker claim lifecycle, protocol reuse, and evidence-based platform recommendation.
Specify a falsifiable multi-instance proof with CI and deployed equivalents.
Decompose INFRA-002..INFRA-007 with scope, acceptance, non-goals and evidence expectations, including COMPAT-CAD-011 coordination.
Preserve frozen Architecture v1.1, authority/engine/version/honesty/secret locks, and require no ACR.
No secrets appear in repository files, PR body, fixtures or generated documents.
non_goals: No store provisioning, Vercel environment wiring, or production deployment changes.
No successor governance records are created here.
risk_assumptions: The serverless problem is state placement rather than a Vercel platform defect.
Production remains fail-closed until external stores are wired.
P016Persist is the precedent for the persistence layer.
Neon is authoritative for transactional state, R2 for immutable object content, Redis never authoritative.
The worker platform recommendation is revisable without redesign.
COMPAT-CAD-011 should consume this foundation rather than duplicate persistence.
evidence_requirements: Auditable traceability against the audited revision.
Disclosure of the pre-existing CAD-PARITY-020 governance defect; it is not fixed here.
No unsupported regression claims beyond the documentation-only scope.
